## About Dhruv Kolhe
Dhruv Kolhe is an undergraduate Computer Science student at Pimpri Chinchwad University (PCU) in Pune, Maharashtra, India. With hands-on experience in software engineering, frontend interface design, backend architecture, and problem-solving, Dhruv develops clean, user-centric digital tools. Outside of programming, he follows Formula 1, enjoys cinema (Letterboxd: @cinepunmaster), television (Serializd: @cinepunmaster), anime, and music.

## Deep-Dive: Technical Competencies

### Languages & Foundations
- TypeScript & JavaScript (ES6+): Strong mastery of asynchronous patterns, DOM manipulation, type definitions, and functional paradigms.
- Python: Applied in backend microservices (FastAPI), scripting, algorithms, and data structures.
- C++: Core understanding of memory management, OOP, and algorithmic problem-solving.
- SQL & Relational Schema Design: Query optimization, relational constraints, indexing.
- HTML5 & Modern CSS3: Semantic architecture, accessibility (WCAG), CSS variables, flexbox, grid, animations.

### Frontend Technologies
- React (v18+): Functional components, custom hooks, context API, state machines, performance profiling.
- Svelte & SvelteKit: Reactive declarations, compile-time performance, server-side data loading.
- Vite: Bundling, module federation, HMR, plugin pipelines, asset optimization.
- Tailwind CSS (v4): Design token integration, custom utility layers, JIT optimization.
- Motion (Framer Motion): Spring physics, scroll-triggered reveals (whileInView), layout animations.

### Backend & Databases
- Node.js & Express.js: REST API routing, middleware chaining, authentication, error handling.
- FastAPI: Python async web framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation and pydantic typing.
- PostgreSQL: Complex joins, ACID transactions, migrations.
- MongoDB: Document modeling, aggregation pipelines.

### DevOps, Tooling & Systems
- Docker: Containerization of multi-service environments and development isolation.
- Linux: Shell scripting, process management, POSIX environments.
- Git & GitHub: Trunk-based development, branch workflows, issue tracking, CI/CD actions.
- Postman: API contract testing and documentation.

## Projects Portfolio

### 1. ProjectHub
- Description: A collaborative developer platform where engineers showcase original software, gather peer feedback, and maintain live interactive portfolios.
- Tech Stack: SvelteKit, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL.
- Repository: https://github.com/dhruvmkolhe/project-hub

### 2. CodeX
- Description: An in-browser collaborative code editor combining real-time multi-user synchronization, AI code assistance, and isolated multi-language code execution.
- Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Node.js, Docker runner.
- Repository: https://github.com/dhruvmkolhe/codex-ide

### 3. LinkForge
- Description: A scalable URL shortening and analytics platform engineered with caching mechanisms, token validation, rate-limiting, and deep traffic analytics.
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Redis, PostgreSQL.
- Repository: https://github.com/dhruvmkolhe/common

## Engineering Philosophy
- Empathy-first UI/UX: Interfaces should be welcoming, accessible, and free of clutter.
- Code Craftsmanship: Writing code that breaks, understanding why it broke, fixing it, and producing reliable, resilient software.
